title: ATWL: A Formal Language for Representing, Comparing, and Reusing Visual Analytics Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2605.25489v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Visual analytics (VA) workflows combine data transformation, feature computation, visual representation, and human interpretation, but they are usually described in prose. This hinders comparison of workflows, reuse of proven strategies, and training of novices. We present Artifact--Transform Workflow Language (ATWL), a declarative language for representing the structure and intent of VA workflows. A workflow consists of typed artifacts and of transforms, each with an analytical intent and a human, machine, or hybrid actor. We built a library of 54 workflows extracted from published VA papers with the help of LLMs under human supervision. An exploratory computational comparison of the library workflows shows regularities, such as a regular division of labour between humans and machines and cycles of refinement. translated_title: ATWL：一种用于表示、比较和重用可视化分析工作流的形式化语言
translated_abstract: 可视化分析（VA）工作流结合了数据变换、特征计算、视觉表示和人类解释，但它们通常以文字形式描述。这阻碍了工作流之间的比较、已验证策略的重用以及对新手的培训。我们提出了工件-变换工作流语言（ATWL），这是一种用于表示可视化分析工作流结构与意图的声明式语言。一个工作流由类型化工件和变换组成，每个变换都具有分析意图以及人类、机器或混合的执行者。我们在人工监督下借助大语言模型（LLM）从已发表的可视化分析论文中提取了54个工作流，构建了一个工作流库。对该库工作流的探索性计算比较显示出一些规律性，例如人与机器之间规律的分工模式以及迭代求精的循环。我们进行了让LLM为新任务设计工作流的实验，这些实验展示了使用该工作流库以及ATWL表示所带来的效果。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种声明式语言ATWL来表示可视化分析工作流的结构与意图，并构建了包含54个工作流的库，揭示了人机分工与迭代求精的规律，同时提升了LLM设计新工作流的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ATWL, a declarative language for representing the structure and intent of visual analytics workflows, and builds a library of 54 workflows that reveals regularities in human-machine division of labor and refinement cycles while improving LLM-based workflow design for new tasks.
